risks: only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~78% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 12): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.322), which favours a weighted combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.6222. Series context: trend strength 0.9656 and seasonal strength 0.8262; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.322); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.969.
